behavior_changes: When two edges with different relations land on the same (src, tgt) pair in an undirected graph, the higher-information relation now wins the collapse instead of the alphabetically last one.

architectural_changes: Added a _RELATION_PRIORITY table to prioritize edge relations during undirected graph collapse, ensuring that higher-information relations take precedence over lower-priority ones.
